facts.statement: Before the shutdown, SOE planned in-game player celebration events; details were to be shared later.
facts.quote: including player celebration in-game events and more!

article_summaries.title: With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Free Realms
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced that Free Realms would be shut down (sunset) on March 31, 2014, roughly two weeks before this capture. The post says the game reached the end of its life cycle as players moved on, and promises player celebration in-game events and further details on the sunset before the end date.
